# demo-wasm

The browser demos, built with Emscripten.

A app.

- **Uses:** `ac3`, `ac4`, `objects`
- **Used by:** nothing
- **CI lanes:** wasm

## Build and test

```sh
cmake --preset config-linux-gcc && cmake --build --preset build-linux-gcc
```

All the projects are in the one CMake build.
